subject: spanish
title: Days of the Week
welcome_lead: Lunes to domingo — the Spanish week.
meta_desc: KS3 Spanish: days of the week.

walkthroughs.body_html: Spanish week begins with lunes: lunes, martes, miercoles, jueves, viernes, sabado, domingo. Like French, days are lowercase.
'Que dia es hoy?' = What day is today? Reply: Hoy es lunes (today is Monday). Manana = tomorrow.
To say 'on Monday' use el lunes. To say 'on Mondays' (every) use los lunes. 'Los lunes voy al gimnasio' = 'On Mondays I go to the gym'.
